children: Capital markets regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and India's premier market infrastructure institutions have kicked off a coordinated social media campaign teasing an upcoming investor-focused initiative, scheduled for an official reveal on Monday (October 5).

The teaser unfolded through a chain of conversational quote-posts on X, involving mutual fund industry body Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI), leading stock exchanges, depositories, and educational bodies.
The thread began with AMFI asking the BSE, "I heard SEBI is coming up with something on investor awareness.. Is it true, @BSEIndia?"
The BSE followed up, indicating that the initiative is aimed at making things simpler: "Yes, we heard it’s going to simplify something. Do you know anything about this @NSEIndia?"

The National Stock Exchange (NSE) tagged commodity exchange MCX, writing, "All I know is that it's for investors. Right,@MCXIndialtd," to which the Multi Commodity Exchange of India responded, "I heard it's about understanding something that seems complex. Isn't it, @CdslIndia."

Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) looped in rival depository National Securities Depository Limited (NSDL), noting, "That’s what I’ve heard too. Something that’s going to make things easier. What is it, @NSDL_Depository?"
NSDL redirected the query to the National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM), stating, "@NISM_Official you told me we're not supposed to reveal anything."

NISM corroborated the secrecy surrounding the announcement, replying, "Exactly! We’ve all heard the rumours, but @SEBI_Awareness has asked us to keep the surprise under wraps. Let’s not reveal it just yet!"
The regulator brought the banter to a close via its official awareness handle, @SEBI_Awareness, posting, "Patience, everyone. By this time tomorrow, the mystery will be over."

The collaborative teaser precedes the launch of the regulator's planned investor initiatives aligned with the upcoming World Investor Week 2026, where SEBI is expanding its digital and educational outreach to demystify complex market products and improve baseline financial literacy across retail participants.

title: SEBI sparks buzz with coordinated investor awareness teaser campaign
